adjudication.rationale: In the newly added webhook handler (apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts), the code does `prisma.credential.findFirst({ where: { userId, appId } })` and then conditionally `update` or `create`. This is a classic check-then-act race: two concurrent requests for the same (userId, appId) can both observe no existing credential and both execute `create`, potentially creating duplicates (or causing an error if a unique constraint exists, which still breaks correctness under concurrency). Also, using `findFirst` without an `orderBy` means if duplicates already exist, which record gets updated is nondeterministic.
